mapper.select: SELECT p.pno, p.thumbnail, p.name, rv.rvno, TO_CHAR(rv.rv_price, '999,999,999') AS form_price, TO_CHAR(rv.rv_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS opday, rv.rv_time, rv.rv_option, TO_CHAR(rv.rv_created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS createday, rv.rv_exposure, rv.rv_status, rf.rf_status, rf.rf_id FROM reserve rv JOIN place p ON p.pno = rv.pno LEFT OUTER JOIN pay pyvo ON rv.rvno = pyvo.rvno LEFT OUTER JOIN refund rf ON pyvo.p_id = rf.p_id WHERE rv.uno = #{uno} AND rv.rv_exposure = 'y' ORDER BY rv.rvno DESC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.thumbnail, p.name, p.company, p.addr, p.phone AS p_phone, rv.rvno, rv.rv_status, rv.rv_time, TO_CHAR(rv.rv_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS opday, rv.rv_option, rv.rv_price, TO_CHAR(rv.rv_price, '999,999,999') AS form_price, rv.rv_amount, rv.nickname, rv.phone AS rv_phone, rv.email, pyvo.totalAmount, pyvo.method, TO_CHAR(pyvo.requestedAt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS requestedAt, pyvo.p_id, rf.rf_status, rf.rf_id, p.pno FROM reserve rv JOIN place p ON p.pno = rv.pno LEFT OUTER JOIN pay pyvo ON rv.rvno = pyvo.rvno LEFT OUTER JOIN refund rf ON pyvo.p_id = rf.p_id WHERE rv.rvno = #{rvno}
